originalFamilyScopeSummary: Fix insufficient funds error when extension size slider is set to 100%
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: fix: extension 'insufficient funds' error when size slider is at 100%
notes: The PR fix (amount-input.tsx: floor the 100% amount to 2 decimals via Math.floor instead of toFixed rounding) directly addresses the root cause — rounding up pushed marginRequired = amount/leverage a sub-cent above availableBalance, producing the false 'Insufficient funds'. Verified live via CDP against branch+merged-main: at 100% size the submit button reads 'Open long ETH' with no 'Insufficient funds' error. Unit tests 39/39 pass; the inherited validation recipe passes (after making its balance gate robust to live HyperLiquid data drift). No reviewer comments were outstanding; branch merged cleanly with origin/main.
